notes: www.mdpi.com returned HTTP 403 to an automated request and PMC blocked its PDF endpoint, so the PDF was fetched from the MDPI asset host at https://res.mdpi.com/d_attachment/sensors/sensors-21-03225/article_deploy/sensors-21-03225.pdf, 3175114 bytes, 10 pages per the PDF metadata although the article paginates to 29. Europe PMC confirms PMCID PMC8125354, isOpenAccess Y, licence 'cc by'. md_quality is rough: the prose is complete and readable but carries soft-hyphen line breaks throughout and page furniture interleaved every page. Specifically unusable: all five equations, which suffered a character-mapping failure and render as (cid:NNNN) codes -- the covariate-shift formalism and the shift-to-median algorithm cannot be read from the extraction; all eight figures, which are image-only, so the t-SNE and principal-component heat-map evidence cannot be checked; and Tables 1, 2 and 3, which were de-tabulated into column-major value runs with headers detached from their rows. Every value quoted from Tables 1 to 3 on the card was reconstructed by positional inference and should be treated as such. That reconstruction is also how the card's list of internal inconsistencies was found -- several are disagreements between a table value and the body prose that states the same quantity.
